definition.centred_2se: 2*SD(d)/sqrt(n_datasets), d = per-dataset F1 delta between two seed replicates. LEGACY.
definition.offset_2se: |mean(d)| + 2*SD(d)/sqrt(n_datasets). RECOMMENDED -- contains the rigid seed offset, which does not average away.
definition.offset_2se_mean/max: mean / max of offset_2se over all unordered seed pairs.
definition.seed_sd_of_task_mean: SD across seeds of the task mean itself.
definition.pairdiff_2sd: 2*sqrt(2)*seed_sd -- 2-sigma bar on the difference of two independent single runs.
